title: No register id in a comment, held by the lint
description: Second half of the register-citation sweep: the citations in files P74, P82, P80 and P81 hold, and in BUG-12's files once the human fix has landed, then the lint extension (parenthesised phase, task and bug ids; measured 51 true of 52 hits over the tree). The lint lands last, because it fails while any citation remains.
desiredOutcome: No comment or docstring in the tree cites a phase, task or bug id in parentheses, and _deps.register_citation_violations() fails the build on one, with every legitimate shape it must leave alone pinned by an allow case.
